channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Indexa/Broadcast: Lula marca 46% contra 41% de Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: An Indexa/Broadcast poll shows President Lula leading the first round with 39% versus 34% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). In a runoff, Lula would beat Flávio 46% to 41%, and holds a 6- to 12-point lead over Caiado, Zema, and Renan Santos. The survey interviewed 2,000 voters with a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast: 51% afirmam que Lula não merece novo mandato em 2026
item.description: Indexa/Broadcast poll reveals 51% of voters disapprove of Lula's management, with 50% saying he does not deserve a new term in 2026. Approval stands at 46%, while disapproval reaches 50%. The survey was released on Tuesday, June 17, 2025.

item.title: Indexa/Broadcast: Renan Santos vence Lula na região Sul do Brasil
item.description: Renan Santos leads with 48% of voting intentions in the South region, surpassing Lula (33%) in a potential runoff, according to an Indexa/Broadcast poll released on March 26. The survey shows the candidate from the Missão à Presidência party gaining an advantage in the southern region.

item.title: Dólar sobe e Ibovespa dispara, puxados pela inflação no Brasil e nos EUA
item.description: The dollar rose 0.40% against the real, trading at R$5.16, while the Ibovespa opened higher, driven by inflation data released in both the US and Brazil. US inflation, measured by the PCE, accelerated to 3.7% annually, exceeding forecasts and maintaining pressure on Fed monetary policy. In Brazil, the IPCA-15 fell 0.40% in August, surpassing expectations and reinforcing the outlook for a Selic rate cut at the next Copom meeting.

item.title: Após faltar na Band, Zema promete comparecer ao próximo debate
item.description: After missing the debate hosted by Band, former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) promised to attend the next one, scheduled for September 14th. His campaign justified the absence due to the no-shows of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Cheiro de recessão no ar (por Hubert Alquéres)
item.description: The article argues that Brazil's economic outlook shows clear recession signs, disconnected from Lula's optimistic campaign slogan. It cites cases like Casas Bahia's bankruptcy filing, record household debt (82%), and Armínio Fraga's comparison to the pre-Dilma crisis, projecting low growth for 2027. The text criticizes the insufficiency of government consumption incentive and debt renegotiation policies to contain fiscal deterioration and foreign capital flight.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas participa de sabatina de VEJA nesta quarta-feira
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas takes part in a VEJA interview on Wednesday as part of its special 2026 election coverage. Conducted by Marcela Rahal, Robson Bonin, and José Benedito, the interview will be live-streamed at 2 PM. Tarcísio runs for reelection against former minister Fernando Haddad (PT), also featured in the series.

item.title: Em cenário de 1º turno, Lula tem 39%, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 34%, mostra pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast
item.description: A survey by Indexa Pesquisas, commissioned by Broadcast, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading first-round polling intentions in the 2026 elections with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 34%. The 5-point gap indicates a tight race between the two most-mentioned candidates.

item.title: Com Lula ou Flávio, economistas mantêm ceticismo sobre ajuste fiscal
item.description: Economists remain skeptical about fiscal adjustment under both Lula and Flávio, with Brazil's public debt likely to keep rising regardless of who wins the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: No 2º turno, Lula lidera com 46% ante 41% de Flávio Bolsonaro, aponta pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast
item.description: A survey by Indexa Pesquisas, commissioned by Broadcast, shows that in the runoff, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 46% of voting intentions, against 41% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The poll was released on Wednesday, the 26th.

item.title: Real Madrid x Real Sociedad: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Real Madrid hosts Real Sociedad on Wednesday, 26, at 16:00 (Brasília time), at the Santiago Bernabéu, in a postponed first-round La Liga 2026/27 match, featuring José Mourinho's return as manager. The team seeks its second consecutive win after a dramatic victory over Espanyol, where Carlos Espí scored the decisive goal. Endrick remains out due to tendinitis, while Real Sociedad responds to their loss against Real Betis.

item.title: Flávio terceiriza prestação de contas de Dark Horse, e repasse de fundo dos EUA segue sem detalhes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, outsourced the accounting of Dark Horse movie funding to the producer Go Up Entertainment without disclosing details about the US fund Havengate that facilitated the payments, failing to uphold his transparency commitment.

item.title: Nunes Marques vai desistir do “selo de acurácia” para institutos de pesquisas?
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques is reconsidering the implementation of an accuracy seal for polling firms, following strong backlash from the research sector and judiciary. The initiative, aimed at enhancing transparency and credibility in electoral polling, has been criticized as excessive institutional oversight.

item.title: Filtro de relevância do STJ entra em vigor em setembro; veja como será o fluxo
item.description: STJ's Regimental Amendment 55, sanctioned on August 4th, takes effect on September 3rd, establishing two pathways for special appeal analysis: one for qualified precedent formation and another for between-party judgments. The new filter requires specific topic and justification regarding federal relevance, potentially leading to dismissal.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado é o segundo convidado de sabatinas de O GLOBO, Valor e CBN; veja onde assistir
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is the second invitee in the 2026 sabatina series organized by O GLOBO, Valor, and CBN, live at 10:30 AM BRT. The series will feature upcoming interviews with Romeu Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury, covering elections in São Paulo and Minas Gerais.

item.title: Flávio tem 45% contra 39% de Lula no 2º turno no TO, diz Big Data
item.description: Real Time Big Data poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 45% against Lula's 39% in the Tocantins second round. Both have 47% rejection rates, based on 1,600 voters surveyed from August 21-25, 2026.

item.title: Lula reúne chefes do Congresso para tentar salvar MP das blusinhas
item.description: President Lula (PT) meets with the Speaker of the Chamber, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), and the Senate President, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), at Alvorada Palace to discuss the progress of the provisional measure suspending the so-called 't-shirt tax'. The meeting aims to secure parliamentary support to advance the proposal.

item.title: Saiba quem é Amanda Vettorazzo, que deu voz de prisão por propina
item.description: São Paulo councilwoman Amanda Vettorazzo (União Brasil) issued an arrest warrant against a man who allegedly offered her a 5% to 10% bribe on a R$60 million contract to sway a public tender for body cameras for the metropolitan police in favor of Oakmont Group. A coordinator of Renan Santos' presidential campaign, Vettorazzo is known for initiatives like the 'anti-Oruam law' and advocacy for smart cities and animal rights. Oakmont Group denied any wrongdoing and said it would thoroughly investigate the matter.

item.title: Vorcaro, EUA, rachadinha: petistas replicam jingle 'Osmarzinho' para criticar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Supporters of Lula mimicked the 'Osmarzinho' jingle to criticize Flávio Bolsonaro, addressing accusations such as millionaire funding for the film 'Dark Horse' with Daniel Vorcaro, embezzlement suspicions in his office, and Jair Bolsonaro's conviction for an attempted coup. The content went viral on social media, generating reactions and replicas, including images of the senator in pre-campaign rallies. Amid the backlash, Osmar Vieira obtained an injunction to remove the posts.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Investigações e ações no Supremo ganham protagonismo nas campanhas e influenciam eleitores
item.description: Supreme Court ministers directly influence the 2026 elections through rulings on investigations and legal actions, such as deepfake definitions and inquiries into INSS and Master. These decisions impact voter behavior and place political figures under investigation.

item.title: PEC da Segurança será analisada na CCJ do Senado na próxima quarta, diz presidente da comissão
item.description: The Security PEC, a priority of President Lula's government, will be analyzed by the Senate's CCJ next Wednesday. The rapporteur, Senator Rogério Carvalho, kept the text approved by the Chamber, speeding up the legislative process.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe R$ 42 milhões do PL para financiar campanha
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) transferred R$42 million to Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign via two Pix transactions. So far, R$5.3 million has been spent on legal services and team travel. Flávio declared assets worth R$8.1 million, including a property in Brasília.

item.title: Pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast: Lula venceria qualquer adversário em segundo turno
item.description: A Indexa/Broadcast poll released on August 26, 2026 shows President Lula (PT) leading first-round scenarios and defeating any opponent in a second round by 5 to over 10 points. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is the closest rival, with 46% against Lula's 41%. The survey interviewed 2,000 people between August 20 and 23 with a 2.2 point margin of error.

item.title: GEO é a nova onda do Marketing Digital para buscas com IA
item.description: The Pew Research Center study reveals that Google's AI Overviews significantly reduce traffic from traditional link clicks, making Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) a priority for Brazilian companies in 2026. With only 8% of clicks on traditional results when AI summaries appear, brands must adapt strategies to be directly selected by AI systems, as users increasingly end sessions after interacting with AI-generated content.

item.title: Por que Lula tem tanto medo de debater sobre os luxos de Lulinha e Marcola
item.description: Leaked cell phone messages obtained by the Federal Police reveal that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger used money from businessmen seeking government favors to pay for luxury expenses of President Lula’s son and his chief of staff, Marcio ‘Marcola’, allegedly constituting influence trafficking now under investigation at the Supreme Court. Facing the allegations, Lula avoids debates and interviews on the matter, repeating his strategy of not commenting on investigations involving relatives and aides.

item.title: Real Time: Professora Dorinha e Vicentinho Jr. têm empate técnico no TO
item.description: Real Time Big Data poll released on August 26th shows a technical tie between Professora Dorinha (33%) and Vicentinho Júnior (30%) in the first round of Tocantins state elections. In second-round scenarios, Dorinha leads against Vicentinho Jr. (41% to 40%) and against Laurez Moreira (49% to 33%). The survey also indicates a tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (36% each) in the presidential race in the state.

item.title: Empresário do ramo de carros doa R$ 300 mil para campanha de Nikolas
item.description: A businessman from Minas Gerais in the vehicle sales and rental sector donated R$ 300,000 to Nikolas Ferreira's re-election campaign. The donation, registered by the TSE, represents 74.26% of the campaign's fundraising goal, which also raised R$ 53,900 through a virtual crowdfunding campaign.

item.title: O estado do Norte em que influência de Lula não será decisiva na eleição, segundo pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows a technical tie between Professora Dorinha Seabra (União-TO) and Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB-TO) in the race for governor of Tocantins, with neither Lula nor Bolsonaro's influence determining the outcome. Laurez Moreira (PSD), backed by Lula, ranks third but faces high rejection in the state.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral reverte uma decisão sobre Marçal
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) overturned a ruling that made Pablo Marçal ineligible until 2032, but two other cases with appeals remain pending at the TSE.

item.title: Um quinto dos petistas votam em Tarcísio, indica Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 20% of PT voters intend to vote for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in the 2026 elections, despite historical PT preference. Tarcísio leads with a large advantage over former minister Fernando Haddad (PT).

item.title: Caiado é certeiro no que é ruim e incerto no que é imprescindível
item.description: With 40 days left until the election, Ronaldo Caiado missed the chance to position the third way during a live interview on TV Globo. He was categorical in criticizing amnesty for coup supporters but avoided detailing his economic platform, saying he couldn't go into specifics. His stance drew criticism for lack of clarity on essential proposals.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no 1º turno em Tocantins, indica Real Time Big Data
item.description: A new poll by Real Time Big Data in Tocantins, conducted between August 21 and 25, 2026, shows President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) tied at 36% in the first-round preference. In a hypothetical runoff, Flávio leads with 45% against Lula's 39%.

item.title: Candidato de Lula em reduto bolsonarista faz pix de R$ 1 milhão para a própria campanha e lidera autodoação
item.description: Gelson Merísio (PSB), gubernatorial candidate for SC backed by Lula, donated R$ 1 million via Pix to his own campaign and leads self-funding rankings in 2026. With a declared net worth of R$ 653,000, he aims to challenge the right-wing dominance in the state, where Jorginho Mello (PL) leads polls.

item.title: “Lulinha virou craque dos negócios”, diz Rogério Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho criticized Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, by suggesting he lives in luxury in Madrid, Spain, while corruption scandals involving the INSS are being investigated in Brazil. Marinho also shared an AI-generated image showing Lulinha in Spain, questioning whether influence was used for private business gain.

item.title: Manchester City anuncia a contratação de Bouaddi, joia de Marrocos
item.description: Manchester City announced the signing of Moroccan midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi, who played for Morocco in the 2026 World Cup. The player, previously with Lille, signed a five-year contract until 2030/2031, with the transfer valued at around €95 million. Bouaddi, born in France, captained Morocco's midfield in the 1-1 draw against Brazil during the World Cup.

item.title: Real Time Big Data em Tocantins: Dorinha e Vicentinho empatam em 1º e 2º turnos
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows a technical tie between Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) and Deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) in first and second round simulations for governor of Tocantins, with a two-point margin of error. Vice-governor Laurez Moreira (PSD) ranks third in the first round and does not advance to the second round.

item.title: Flávio tem 47% e Lula, 42% em 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on August 26, 2026, shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 47% of voting intentions against 42% for President Lula (PT) in a potential second round. The survey also found that 51% of voters disapprove of Lula's administration. The study surveyed 2,400 voters between August 21 and 25, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: O estado onde eleitores ‘lulistas’ admitem votar no governador da direita
item.description: Quaest polls reveal that 70% of Southern voters remain undecided for governor. Despite strong anti-PT sentiment, conservative leaders like Jorginho Mello lead, even attracting some 'Lula' supporters. Preference for Bolsonaro-aligned figures persists, but voter intentions remain highly unstable ahead of October elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro queima largada e apela por voto útil da direita
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) kicked off his early campaign and called for a 'useful vote' to consolidate the right-wing against rivals like Caiado, Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury. This rushed move signals insecurity and may damage alliances ahead of a potential runoff.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Real Time Big Data testa disputa Lula x Flávio após entrevistas e início da campanha na TV
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data survey measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, analyzing voting intentions, rejection rates, electoral potential, and opinion indicators about the country. Data collection runs from June 26 to 29, covering the start of the electoral campaign on TV and radio. The poll includes first and second-round simulations with multiple candidates.

item.title: Caiado critica a reforma tributária e diz que pretende modificá-la
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized the tax reform approved by Congress and said he intends to modify it if elected. The statements were made during an interview on the Jornal Nacional newscast on TV Globo.

item.title: Lula passou a ser um grande agiota, diz Caiado, sobre o endividamento do brasileiro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD candidate for the presidency, referred to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'loan shark' during a TV Globo interview, criticizing the Desenrola Brasil program and the Brazilian people's debt. The statement occurred on Tuesday, 25th, and emphasized his stance on economic policies.

item.title: Eduardo posta vídeo antigo de ato de Jair Bolsonaro com multidão como se fosse de Flávio no Nordeste
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared an old video of former president Jair Bolsonaro, falsely presenting it as footage from his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's first campaign rally in the Northeast. The post aims to suggest popular support for the Bolsonaro family in a region where Flávio faces strong leadership from Lula, according to recent polls.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no Amazonas, segundo pesquisa Real Time Big Data
item.description: A survey by the Real Time Big Data institute shows that President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are tied in the preference of Amazonas voters for the 2026 presidential race. In the first round, Lula leads by one percentage point (40% vs 39%), while in the second round the order inverts (43% for Flávio and 41% for Lula). The gap falls within the two-point margin of error.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Flávio Bolsonaro faz motociata, Lula encontra Motta e Alcolumbre
item.description: On Wednesday, August 26, 2026, President Lula (PT) has no campaign schedule and is in Brasília meeting with the presidents of the Chamber and Senate to discuss governmental agendas, including pension reform. Meanwhile, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) maintains an active agenda in Arapiraca, Alagoas, with a motorcycle parade, rally, and meetings with the productive sector. Other candidates such as Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, and Renan Canto also carry out regional activities and media appearances.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: Capitão Alberto Neto lidera disputa pelo Senado no Amazonas
item.description: Federal deputy Capitão Alberto Neto (PL) leads Senate vote intentions in Amazonas with 24%, followed by Wilson Lima (União Brasil) and Eduardo Braga (MDB) tied at 19% and 18% respectively, according to Real Time Big Data survey with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Daniel Perez, nominated as future U.S. ambassador to Brazil, states he will not involve himself in Brazilian politics and will respect the October election outcome, working with whoever wins. His statement reflects a stance of neutrality and respect for Brazil's democratic process.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 4ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE will be released for publication starting Wednesday (August 26, 2026), covering 7 Brazilian states. The content does not mention specific candidates, focusing only on the rules for publishing polling data.

item.title: Novas pesquisas mostram disputa Lula x Flávio nos três maiores colégios eleitorais do Brasil
item.description: The Quaest polls show that the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is extremely tight in Brazil's three largest electoral colleges, with margins of at most two percentage points. In São Paulo and Minas Gerais, the candidates are tied when Pablo Marçal is included, while in Rio de Janeiro, Flávio holds a slight numerical lead.

item.title: Plenário do STF: saiba quais ações estão na pauta desta 4ª feira
item.description: The STF will rule on Wednesday on actions regarding the Public Ministry's subpoena powers and the financial proof requirement for free legal aid in Labor Justice. The court, now composed of 10 ministers following Barroso's retirement, examines cases involving checks and balances between powers and access to justice.
